text.p: Novavax Inc said on Thursday it hired Vector Securities as a financial adviser, to help the company with licensing pacts, strategic alliances, joint ventures or other deals involving its drug products.
Novavax is a pharmaceutical delivery company engaged in the development and testing of encapsulated pharmaceuticals, anti-infectives and adjuvants.

The company has three products in human clinical trials -- Estrasorb and Androsorb, which deliver alcohol soluble pharmaceuticals through the skin via a cream, and Helicore, a non-antibiotic anti-microbial oral preparation.

Estrasorb is being developed as a topical hormone replacement therapy for menopausal women while Androsorb is being developed as a topical hormone replacement therapy for testosterone-deficient males, it said.
Helicore is being developed to fight a causitive agent in ulcers, gastritis and certain stomach cancers.
